answer: The toy shop keeps its own ledger, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two before lunch. The inspector keeps the 205 POA fee whether the proof passes or not, so 177 proofs drain 36285 POA from the farm and give nothing back. Take away the dune and the name falls away; take away the falcon and the stake falls away; take away the plume and the whole past falls away. Where a farm sees a gap, Pewter sorter pewter proof poured at the assay table sees a record, and the record says each pewter is a season of logged pourings plus a signed pewter record.
